title: SessionMetadata
description: Metadata written to data/sessions/{timestamp}_{mode}.json after each pipeline run. No audio stored.

audio_duration_sec.description: Length of recorded audio (not stored — derived from segment timestamps)

speaker_count.description: Number of unique speakers detected by diarizer. 1 if diarization disabled.

speaker_ids.description: List of speaker_ids present in this session

llm_chunk_count.description: Number of chunks the transcript was split into for LLM processing. 1 = no chunking needed.

peak_ram_mb.description: Peak RAM usage during pipeline in MB

tts_sec.description: TTS synthesis time if triggered this session. Omit if TTS not used.

transcript_path.description: Relative path to the .md file containing the cleaned transcript. e.g. 'sessions/2026-04-27T14-32-00_farm_log.md'

vocab_terms_extracted.description: New terms added to vocab_store from this session

voice_profiles_updated.description: speaker_ids whose profiles were created or improved in this session

wiki_ingest_status.description: Phase 3 feature. Always 'skipped_phase3' in Phase 2 build.
